check: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q && grep -q "def _normalize" validators.py && [ "$(grep -c "split()" validators.py)" = "1" ]
title: Extract repeated code into one helper without changing behavior
prompt: validators.py repeats the same three-line normalization (strip, collapse inner whitespace, lower-case) in three functions. Move it into one helper named _normalize(value) and use it in all three functions. Behavior must not change and the tests must keep passing. Do not change the tests.
